info.title: Recipe Box API
info.description: Conventions, error codes and limits: docs/API.md. Every non-2xx response is an `ErrorBody`.

post.summary: Signs in with a username and password.

401.description: Wrong username or password; the same answer for both (`unauthenticated`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Always succeeds, even without a session.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).
Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

get.summary: Backup zip with `recipes.json` and `media/*`. Admin only.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

501.description: Not built yet (`not_implemented`); every call returns this today.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

get.summary: What the server can do, so the UI can hide AI features.

200.description: Whether an AI provider is configured.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Restores a backup zip, skipping recipes whose id exists. Admin only.

200.description: Counts of imported and skipped recipes.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

501.description: Not built yet (`not_implemented`); every call returns this today.

post.summary: Reads a recipe from photos (PHO-2–5). Returns a draft with `photoImageIds` set.

200.description: The draft. `photoImageIds` lists the stored photos in upload order; in `dish` mode `imageId` is the first.

400.description: No files, more than 6, or a bad `mode` (`validation`).

415.description: A file is not an image we can read, including a HEIC the server cannot decode (`unsupported_media`). Nothing is kept.

422.description: No AI provider (`ai_disabled`) or no recipe in the photos (`no_recipe_found`). The photos stay stored and `error.photoImageIds` lists them.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

502.description: The AI provider failed (`ai_error`). The photos stay stored and `error.photoImageIds` lists them.

post.summary: Reads a recipe from pasted text with AI (LNK-3/4). Returns a draft.

422.description: No recipe in the text (`no_recipe_found`), or no AI provider (`ai_disabled`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

501.description: Not built yet (`not_implemented`); every call returns this today.

post.summary: Reads a recipe from a web page (LNK-1/2/5/7). Returns a draft; saves nothing.

200.description: The draft. `sourceUrl` is the final URL after redirects.

422.description: No recipe on the page (`no_recipe_found`), or the address is not public (`blocked_address`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

502.description: The site refused us (`site_blocked`), or the fetch failed or timed out (`fetch_failed`).

post.summary: Uploads an image. It is decoded and re-encoded (JPEG, long edge at most 2400 px), never stored as sent.

415.description: Not a readable image, or over 10,000 px a side or 40 megapixels (`unsupported_media`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

parameters.description: Default `newest`, or relevance when `q` is set.

200.description: A page of recipes; `total` counts all matches.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

put.summary: Replaces every field of a live recipe.

400.description: Invalid field, unknown image id or malformed id (`validation`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

delete.summary: Soft delete; the row is purged a day later.

404.description: No such recipe, or already deleted (`not_found`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Undoes a delete made in the last 10 minutes.

get.summary: Whether the first admin still has to be created.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Creates the first admin and signs them in. Only allowed while there are no users.

400.description: Invalid username, display name or password (`validation`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

get.summary: Tags used by live recipes, with counts, sorted by name.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

get.summary: All users, ordered by display name. Admin only.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Adds a household member. Admin only.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

delete.summary: Removes a user. Not yourself, not the last admin.
delete.description: Their sessions go with them (FK cascade); recipes stay, with `created_by`/`updated_by` set to null (FK `set null`).

403.description: Not an admin, removing yourself, or removing the last admin (`forbidden`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

put.description: Own password: `currentPassword` required. Admin resetting another user's: not needed. Ends the user's other sessions.

204.description: Password changed; the user's other sessions ended.

401.description: Not signed in, or wrong `currentPassword` for your own account (`unauthenticated`).

403.description: A member changing someone else's password (`forbidden`).

Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

BinaryFile.description: Raw bytes in a response (an image or a zip).

ErrorCode.description:
The `code` of an error response (docs/API.md "Errors"). `api_unreachable` and `network` are not in it: the
frontend proxy and browser client make those up.

photoImageIds.description: Photo import only: the photos were stored but no draft could be made.

ImportSummary.description: Result of importing a backup zip.

RecipeDraft.description: What the import endpoints return; never saved by them. The client POSTs the reviewed draft to `/api/recipes`.

RecipeSort.description: Sort orders for `GET /api/recipes`; the handler matches the raw string, so anything else is a 400.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC.

session.description: httpOnly session cookie set by login and setup.
